verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI review docs describe a metrics view that 'shows metrics like issues found, acceptance rates, and PRs reviewed over time' (graphite-docs-49). This maps to findings, acceptance rates and review coverage, and the separate Insights product measures team developer productivity (graphite-docs-13). AI reviews can be enabled across the whole organization (graphite-docs-47), which supports org-wide scope. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the dashboard, explicit org-wide aggregation and review-coverage percentage metrics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
